item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #VISPRSD
Issued at 01:17 AM 29 November 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Iloilo(Lambunao, Calinog, Bingawan), #Capiz(Tapaz, Jamindan, Mambusao, Ivisan, SapiAn, Dumalag), #Aklan(Altavas, NewWashington, Batan), #NegrosOriental(CityOfGuihulngan, Bindoy, Manjuyod, LaLibertad, Jimalalud, Tayasan) and #Cebu(Moalboal) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Guimaras(NuevaValencia), #NegrosOccidental(CadizCity), #Capiz(RoxasCity, Panay, Panitan, Sigma, Dao, Cuartero, Dumarao), #Iloilo(CityOfPassi, Dueñas), #NegrosOriental(Vallehermoso), #Cebu(Dumanjug and Ronda) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
